description: This file is a Lua script for a graphics/canvas project, demonstrating image loading, cropping, and basic animation within a setup and draw loop.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the graphics environment, loads an image, performs cropping, and outputs image sizes.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Draws the images on the canvas, displays text, and updates animated image positions with boundary checks to create bouncing movement.
